description: Lists every country and region Slashtel sells travel data eSIMs for (about 200 destinations), returning each destination's code, name, lowest live price in USD and number of plans. Use it to find the destination code when the user names a place, a region such as Europe or Asia, or is unsure what is covered. Optional search text filters by name. Skip this tool and call get_esim_plans directly when you already know the ISO-2 country code.

search.description: Optional. Part of a country or region name to filter by, e.g. 'turk', 'japan' or 'europe'. Leave empty to list all destinations.

name: list_esim_destinations
title: List eSIM destinations
